row.body:
My note says the farm crew washed their sample jars in this sink. The water turned milky; two hours later a patrol told us not to use the tap.

Nobody agreed on whose list this belonged to. I left it where the next person would look for the things we still owed each other.

Perhaps the new instructions were meant to help us. They arrived after we had already followed the old ones.

row.body:
They told us to throw away the board but to leave the knife. I said we had served from both, and the man at the door asked only who had signed the delivery.

My helper had signed because I was late. She stayed behind to clean when they took the board. They asked for her address, then said she could go home.

We still have the order book. A page is gone, though the food from that order was already on the table.
row.title: The missing cutting board
